mechanism: Irbesartan may potentiate the anticholinergic effects of benztropine, and benztropine's anticholinergic activity can reduce blood pressure control and increase orthostatic hypotension risk when combined with the antihypertensive effect of irbesartan.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and counsel patients on orthostatic precautions; assess for excessive anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation) and adjust benztropine dose if needed.
